subject: Vendor onboarding: billing handshakes, CSV template, portal vs email
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lumensupply Billing <billing@lumensupply.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — preferred invoice channel + onboarding form

Hi Sasha / Lumensupply team,

Thanks for starting the vendor activation process with Redwood. We want to lock in the most reliable path for invoice submissions so your invoices post quickly and PO matching is accurate. A few high-level asks so we can finalize onboarding: 

- Preferred ingestion channel: we strongly recommend the portal (preferred) for structured invoices or the SMTP fallback (billing@invoices.redwood.com) only for legacy PDFs.
- PO visibility: can you ensure the PO number is in the subject or a prominent header (PO: 12345)? If you stamp POs on PDFs we can accept that but a separate CSV/lineitem file helps reconciliation.
- Multi-PO invoices: do you ever consolidate multiple POs onto one invoice? If yes, how do you present line items and PO references?

Attached is our vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf — please complete pages 1–2 and return. I also attached a simple CSV template link we use internally; if Lumensupply can export a similar CSV that will speed up mapping.

Next steps: fill and return the form, and let us know whether you prefer portal first or email fallback. If portal, we’ll send a vendor invite and a short SSO/access note.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Supplier Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)
From: Sasha Green <sasha@lumensupply.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumensupply Billing <billing@lumensupply.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — preferred invoice channel + onboarding form

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the note and the form. Quick answers from our side: 

- Channel: Our AP team primarily uses AriaProcure portal for large customers but we can send invoices via SMTP if needed. Portal would be ideal for tracking.
- PO stamping: We can include PO numbers both in the PDF header and as a CSV field; our current export includes PO, item description, qty, unit price, tax, and line-level PO reference.
- Multi-PO: We do sometimes consolidate: a single invoice can reference multiple PO numbers. When that happens we include a separate CSV with a PO column per line item.

Two clarifying questions: 
1) Do you require a specific filename convention for CSVs or PDFs when using the SMTP fallback?
2) For portal ingestion, what is the expected field for matching when multiple POs are present (PO on invoice level vs PO on line item)?

I’m attaching a redacted sample invoice (sample_invoice_20270519.pdf) so you can see our current layout. Happy to hop on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best,
Sasha Green
Billing Manager, Lumensupply Inc.

Attachment: sample_invoice_20270519.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Green <sasha@lumensupply.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — preferred invoice channel + onboarding form

Hi Sasha — this is perfect, thanks for the sample. A couple internal notes and our recommended path (looping Jordan, Marissa, and Karthik for ops/engineering details):

- Filename convention (SMTP fallback): please use REDWOOD_INV_<vendor>_<YYYYMMDD>_<invoice#>.pdf or .csv. Example: REDWOOD_INV_LUMENSUPPLY_20270519_INV4789.pdf. That makes automated subject-token parsing simpler.

- Portal ingestion: recommend you onboard to our portal (we’ll send an invite) and include PO numbers on the line-item level when multiple POs exist. Our matcher prefers line-item PO references for consolidated invoices — it yields better PO-to-line mapping and reduces manual exceptions.

- CSV template: we’ve attached redwood_invoice_csv_template_v1.csv (link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Redwood-Invoice-CSV-Template-v1). Key columns we require: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), currency, po_number (line-level), item_description, qty, unit_price, tax_amount, line_total. If you map PO at line level, please repeat the PO value on each corresponding row.

- PO stamping & acknowledgement: if you prefer PDFs only, include a single header-level PO for single-PO invoices; for multi-PO invoices please also upload the CSV. We will accept both but portal + CSV is lowest friction.

Operational ask: can you fill pages 1–2 of the onboarding form and return by Monday 24 May? Once we have the completed form we’ll provision the portal user and share SSO steps and optional API keys for direct CSV upload.

If you want, I can schedule a 20-min walk-through with Jordan (ops) to confirm mappings — suggested times below.

Available slots (Pacific time):
- Fri 21 May, 9:00–9:30am PT
- Mon 24 May, 10:30–11:00am PT

Thanks — we’ll standby after you return the form.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Supplier Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_invoice_csv_template_v1.csv (CSV, 3KB)
From: Sasha Green <sasha@lumensupply.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumensupply Billing <billing@lumensupply.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — preferred invoice channel + onboarding form

Thanks Vanessa — that all makes sense and aligns with our internal exports. We will: 

1) Complete and return the onboarding form (pages 1–2) by EOD Monday 24 May.
2) Adopt the filename convention for any SMTP submissions.
3) Start provisioning a CSV export with the exact columns you listed; we’ll validate against your sample template and drop a test file into the portal once we receive the invite.

Please go ahead and provision the portal access for our AP user (sasha@lumensupply.com). A short walkthrough on Monday 24 May at 10:30am PT would be great — that slot works for our team.

Appreciate the clarity — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Sasha Green
Billing Manager, Lumensupply Inc.
